title: Newsweek — 'Russia Deepens Connections With North Korea': 두만강 교량 전략적 함의, 군사물자 이동 용이, 상호방위조약 맥락
snippet: Newsweek reported on the strategic implications of the new Tumen River road bridge connecting Russia and North Korea. The bridge will offer a useful route to transfer military goods and munitions - both to North Korea and to Russia. Experts say the rush to open the bridge indicates Kim Jong Un's enthusiasm for cooperation with Moscow. The article contextualizes this within the 2024 mutual defense pact signed by Putin and Kim, with approximately 15,000 North Korean troops deployed to the Russian front.
tag_reason: 5/20 보고서의 '러-북 군사협력 $14.4B 구조적 동맹화' 항목과 연결. 두만강 교량의 군사물자 이동 용이성이라는 새로운 구체적 함의 추가. 상호방위조약과 교량 건설의 연결 분석이 새로운 정보.
